purpose: Post-pilot all-dictionary stress test fixed before execution; tests the distinction between prefix debt and outstanding audits without tuning to outcomes

scenarios.name: outcome-lag-64
scenarios.description: Marks with branch/success indicator one return after 64 additional episode boundaries; other launched marks return at the next boundary.

scenarios.name: single-blocker
scenarios.description: The first launched audit of each type is withheld until after the learning horizon; every later launched audit returns at the next boundary. Maximum unreturned count is one per launched type, while chronological prefix debt can grow linearly.

selection: Same fixed 27-law dictionary, policy class, tie rules, confidence delta, common random worlds and seven methods as the pilot. No result-dependent exclusions or hyperparameter changes.
retention: Per-run and 32-episode checkpoint summaries are retained; the deterministic standard-library runner regenerates every episode.
